result: At the fish table, Hana took the pad and started the top edge from the tail tip while Maya traced the bottom edge to meet it. Sofia laid a tail fin, but Priya worried its prongs ran back against the fall and wouldn't catch. Sam agreed, the prongs came off the pad, and both edges splayed forward from START so the tail forked instead. Grace's notch was dropped to keep the edges clean. Then the clock ran down. Sam kept working the connect from the bottom edge's start, and the team waited on his word: "Hold the join until I call it." Grace finally took the tail-tip join, Jack bridged the nose, and Hana flagged a sharp bend near START just before the push. When the start domino fell, 111 of 162 went down. Every player called it a fish. The blind judges all guessed a leaf, along with a fish and a boat.
